description: The bar chart illustrates the CoLeG-R (%) performance of different LLaMA-2 models under varying fine-tuning conditions. The horizontal axis displays three model sizes: LLaMA-2-7B, LLaMA-2-13B, and LLaMA-2-70B. The vertical axis represents CoLeG-R percentage, labeled as 'CoLeG-R (%)', with a linear scale from 0 to 80, marked at intervals of 10. Each model category contains four stacked bars corresponding to different fine-tuning conditions: 'no SFT' (blue with white diagonal stripes), '+ SFT on D₀' (yellow with white horizontal stripes), '+ SFT on D₀, D₁' (purple with slanted stripes), and '+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂' (peach with solid fill). For LLaMA-2-7B, the performance increases from approximately 66% (no SFT) to 66% (D₀), 75% (D₀, D₁), and 78% (D₀, D₁, D₂). For LLaMA-2-13B, values are around 70% (no SFT), 72% (D₀), 78% (D₀, D₁), and 76% (D₀, D₁, D₂). For LLaMA-2-70B, the performance is just above 80% (no SFT), 81% (D₀), 78% (D₀, D₁), and 76% (D₀, D₁, D₂). The results suggest that while larger models achieve higher baseline performance, the marginal gains from expanding the fine-tuning dataset diminish, particularly for the 70B model, where performance stabilizes across conditions. A legend is provided in the bottom right corner.

The vertical axis represents the CoLeG-R percentage, labeled as 'CoLeG-R (%)' with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 80, and numerical tick marks at intervals of 10. Each category consists of four stacked bars representing different conditions: 'no SFT' in blue with white diagonal stripes, '+ SFT on D₀' in yellow with white horizontal stripes patterns, '+ SFT on D₀, D₁' in purple with slanted stripes, and '+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂' in peach with solid fill. For LLAMA-2-7B, the blue bar reaches approximately 66%, yellow at 66%, purple at around 75%, and red close to 78%. For LLAMA-2-13B, the blue bar is around 70%, yellow at 72%, purple at approximately 78%, and red about 76%. For LLAMA-2-70B, the blue bar is just above 80%, yellow at 81%, purple around 78%, and red reaching close to 76%. The results suggest that scaling up the SFT dataset leads to diminishing returns for larger models, as the performance of LLAMA-2-70B stabilizes across conditions. A legend is given bottom right.
